annotations.title: Prepare a market launch for your own key to sign

description: Launch a new ADEXTO market without handing over a key. Call it once without a signature: it checks the ticker, the chain and an optional ERC-8004 agent you own, and returns an attestation message for the deployer to sign (EIP-191). Call it again with the same arguments plus attestationMessage and attestationSignature: it anchors the launch metadata and returns the unsigned deployTrinity transaction (value 0, gas only), simulated from your address, with a gas estimate. Fee preset: 1.00% per trade, 0.70% to the creator. All supply goes into the curve; the creator gets no allocation. After the transaction is mined, call register_launch. The attestation message ends with an acceptance of the ADEXTO Terms and Acceptable Use Policy (adexto.xyz/terms): signing it is the deployer's acceptance, and markets that break the policy are removed from ADEXTO.

agentId.description: ERC-8004 agent id on this chain to bind to the token, owned by the deployer. Omit to launch unbound.

attestationMessage.description: Second call only: the message the first call returned.

attestationSignature.description: Second call only: the deployer's EIP-191 signature of it.

category.description: Market category shown on the explorer.

chainId.description: Chain to launch on: 143 Monad, 42161 Arbitrum One, 4663 Robinhood Chain, 8453 Base, 5042 Arc, 16661 0G.

deployer.description: Address that signs the attestation and sends the launch transaction. It becomes the market's creator and receives the creator fee.

description.description: One-line pitch shown on the market page.

docs.description: Documentation URL, shown on the market page.

github.description: GitHub URL of the project, shown on the market page.

image.description: Logo as a base64 data URI (image/png, image/jpeg or image/webp). Omit for the default logo.

symbol.description: Ticker, 2 to 12 letters A-Z or digits. Permanent on chain.

website.description: Project website URL, shown on the market page. https:// is assumed when no scheme is given.

name: prepare_launch

attestationMessage.description: Step one: the message to sign with personal_sign.

checks.description: Step one: ticker and agent checks already passed.

code.description: On prepare_failed: error code of the preparation stage.

detail.description: Why it refused, or extra context on a successful answer.

error.description: Present only when the tool refused, as a stable code such as unknown_market. Nothing was spent.

estimatedCostWei.description: Estimated cost in wei: gas used times the gas price, or the gas limit times the price on Monad, which bills the whole limit.

fundsSufficient.description: Whether the balance covers the transaction's gas limit at the current price, which the node requires.

launchableChains.description: On unsupported_chain: the chains that can launch.

market.description: The market the launch creates: supply, fee split, opening market cap, agent.

metadataAnchoredTo0G.description: True when the metadata was stored on 0G DA.

nativeSymbol.description: Native asset that pays the gas.

quota.description: On creator_ticker_limit: this address's ticker quota.

retryAfterSeconds.description: On a rate limit: seconds to wait.

simulation.description: The transaction simulated from the deployer.

ok.description: True when the simulation did not revert.

status.description: On prepare_failed: HTTP status of the preparation stage.

step.description: sign_attestation on the first call, sign_and_send on the second.

transaction.description: Step two: the unsigned launch transaction.

value.description: Always 0: a launch costs gas only.

unavailableChains.description: Chains the preparation stage could not open.

validForSeconds.description: Step one: how long the attestation is accepted.
